text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Every time I come to watch her, she's
training
like there's no tomorrow. All of
them, really—you
can tell how eager
they are to shine.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm fortunate to have met such hard
workers...
truly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A smile spreads across Light Hello's face
as she
watches <chrname>
train.
